name: Astral Threshold
author: Motif
description: Violet and ice-blue volumetric membranes: foreground curtains, middle sheets and a distant aperture. Step-normalised volume rendering. Nine seamless infinite loops.

styles.name: Astral Threshold Hero
styles.blurb: Seven offset membranes recede to a distant aperture; the camera leans in and returns.

aperture.label: Aperture radius
aperture.hint: Radius of the innermost shell and the distant aperture.

filament.label: Filament scale
filament.hint: Spacing of the fine filaments on each membrane. Smaller = more filaments.

warp.label: Warp amplitude
warp.hint: How far each membrane folds away from a circle.

absorb.label: Absorption
absorb.hint: How strongly membranes block what lies behind them.

travel.label: Depth travel
travel.hint: Closed camera excursion into the passage and back.

advect.label: Advection cycles per loop
advect.hint: Whole cycles the filaments slide along the membranes per loop.

exposure.label: Exposure
exposure.hint: Linear exposure before the single tone map.

bloom.label: Bloom
bloom.hint: Glow added around emissive light. 0 shows the bare geometry.

bloomRadius.label: Bloom radius
bloomRadius.hint: Width of the glow relative to the frame.

lensCA.label: Edge fringe
lensCA.hint: Spectral fringing toward the frame edge.

vignette.label: Vignette
vignette.hint: Darkens the frame edge; never touches the focal area.

quality.label: Quality
quality.hint: Sample counts only. Composition, phase and exposure stay the same.
